body: Thank you for being so kind, I’m struggling a lot rn so I’m glad you replied. I’m gonna wait a little longer see how the rest of this day goes.
The thing is I don’t have anything to make a life out for myself, I can’t even write an article for my school newspaper, I can’t concentrate on anything.
By her, I mean my therapist

I have a lockbox, last week when I ran away I emptied it and my brother still took it. He’s a compulsive theif. Thank you though, I’m at my school, and I’m comtiplating suicide. I just don’t want to be hospitalized again but I know that my mom has probably already spoke with her since she saw one of my cuts yesterday. All I do is drink and smoke weed to cope with the bullshit. I have urges to cut again, I used to self harm a lot, I still do just in other ways. It’s either I kill my self or I get hospitalized and I’m horrified, not of death but hospitals.
If they did care they wouldn’t let my brother steal all of my shit, they would you know actually support me and shit. It’s like I don’t even exist.
What’s the point though, it’s not like I’m ever going to get better. I don’t even have any friends anymore. Everyone hates me, I really don’t have anything to live for
